log.summary: Last Word Chasm is cited in session travel planning as a flight-time reference: Elrus previously told Walker that dragon flight from the chasm to the Dragon Rider training grounds takes about five days.
notes: Used as a travel-time reference point: about five days by flight to the Dragon Rider training grounds per Elrus.

log.summary: The searched cave is a small roost-and-study. One side is a dragon roost of decomposed dirt, entrance weeds, fungi, and bat guano, with no bedding. The other side is a study where Vecna sits at a square slab table. Faint papery scraps remain where maps once were. Three chairs are each cut from a single piece of lighter stone. Old troop markers lie on the floor and a few remain on the table. Four crude landscape reliefs run along the back wall and into the roost. The search does not find a phylactery.
